description.narrative: The project is implemented in Bosnia and Herzegovina (BiH). The main outcome areas it contributes to are democracy and human rights, equality and workers' rights, countering climate change. The main rights holders are workers and citizens in general. Through engaged research, critical education, public work and platform building the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThis project is a cooperation between CRVENA Association for Culture and Art and the National Secretariat of the Workers Educational Association (ABF-frbundet). Crvena is a membership based organisation dedicated to democratic development in BiH through popular participation. ABF is Swedens largest association for popular education and is present in all municipalities. The National Secretariat supports the growth of operations within the ABF organisation.Project ObjectiveThe project objective is strong and influential civic platform promoting policies aimed at economically, socially and environmentally sustainable and fair development of Sarajevo and Bosnia-Herzegovina.
